name: web-browse
description: Open a URL in a real browser and return the text a person would see. Needs chromium at /usr/bin/chromium.

tools.name: web_browse
tools.description: Open a URL in a real browser, let the page's scripts run, and return the text a person would see. Use this when web_fetch says the page is assembled by its scripts, or for a page you already know needs them — a single-page app, an infinite-scroll feed, a dashboard. It costs far more than web_fetch and takes seconds rather than milliseconds, so reach for web_fetch first unless you know the page needs a browser. A non-HTML body comes back verbatim.
